thread:
PagerDutyBot: P0 - Dedicated reserved pool 'resv-eu-1' at 100% utilization (tenant: BrightLeaf). Queue growth alarm. Pager: Devon

Devon: oncall here, acknowledging. forming ops-bridge in 2m. who has infra oncall? :wave:

Sara: i'm up. pulling dashboards now. brightleaf enqueue rate spiked ~08:12 UTC, reserved allocations at 100% and autoscaler not adding nodes.

Mike: autoscaler log snippet:
```
[autoscaler] loop: desired=8 current=8 pending=0 max_allowed=8 lock=true
[autoscaler] reason: max_reserved_hard_lock -> cannot provision additional hosts
```

Chen: that's the new config flag resv_max_lock from yesterday's rollout. looks like some pools got a static cap.

Devon: options: 1) increase pool cap temporarily, 2) route to hosted fallback, 3) evict noisy sessions. preferences?

Sara: i'd vote for short cap bump + targeted eviction. fallback routing will increase latency for BrightLeaf and may break SLAs.

Kasia: BrightLeaf CSM here. customer is seeing ~12% error rate and long tails. they want ETA and mitigation plan. please advise.

Mike: i can increase resv-eu-1.max_reserved from 8 -> 12 and restart autoscaler. will take ~90s to take effect. initiating now.

[system] Mike edited config: resv-eu-1.max_reserved := 12

[deploy-bot] deploy started: infra/autoscaler-config (user: mike)

Sara: queue peaked at ~540 -> dropping after new hosts scheduling. still some hotspots on older nodes.

Chen: root cause: feature flag mis-implemented — resv_max_lock read from env at start, not from quota-service. reproducer attached to RCA.

Devon: Sara, can you run eviction script for the top noisy sessions from brightleaf-rt? Graceful drain only.

Sara:
```
# graceful drain
tool/resvctl drain --pool resv-eu-1 --tenant brightleaf-rt --grace 25
```

[system] eviction jobs created: 20 sessions

Sara: queue length now down to ~60. error rate falling: 12% -> 3.5% for brightleaf endpoints.

Kasia: updated BrightLeaf: "Thanks, please send timeline and we'll schedule postmortem call tomorrow." They asked for temporary mitigation details.

Mike: rolling back the problematic flag so max_reserved is read from quota-service again. deploying rollback.

[deploy-bot] deploy completed: rollback infra/autoscaler-config (user: mike)

Devon: follow-ups: Chen to own RCA, Mike to land PR adding hard-fail safeties and auto-fallback after 30s of scale_limit, Sara to add alert for 'autoscaler.locked_max_reserved' and evict script runbook, Kasia to own customer comms.

Chen: acknowledged, i'll write RCA and include timelines and test plan.

Sara: monitoring for 45m, metrics stable.

[ops-note] incident_state: mitigated -> monitoring

Kasia: BrightLeaf oncall confirmed errors subsiding and agreed to follow-up call tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Devon: closing: incident mitigated. created PD incident 5391234567 and follow-up tasks. thanks everyone.

PagerDutyBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated) — follow-ups created: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/5391234567

[reactions] Devon:+1, Sara:eyes, Mike:rocket
